When the partner roster grows faster than the team, co-sell motions stall because nobody's working each partner's accounts at scale. Most teams don't know how many of those joint accounts they're actually touching, so the gap shows up in QBRs, late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a pipeline gap analysis showing exactly where Bolt's partner-sourced coverage is leaking and how many meetings closes it this quarter.
